content.short: IPFS is a Web3-based distributed file storage protocol.
content.description: IPFS is a Web3 distributed file storage protocol designed to overcome traditional storage limits by delivering a secure and permanent storage solution. It enables users to store and retrieve content across a decentralized network, with access from web browsers, desktop applications, and the command-line interface. By distributing data across participating nodes, IPFS provides a robust storage framework that remains available even when individual components fail.
